content:
Every platform vendor brags about their Gartner Magic Quadrant position. Press releases. Landing pages. Sales decks. "We're a Leader for the sixth consecutive year! Most buyers see this marketing but never read the actual reports. That's a missed opportunity. The Magic Quadrant isn't just a badge platforms put on their website. It's a tool that helps you evaluate which platform fits your specific needs.

In this issue

  • Why the Magic Quadrant Exists. Gartner created the Magic Quadrant to help enterprise buyers evaluate technology vendors.
  • The Two Quadrants I'm Covering This Year. Gartner publishes these reports annually on a predictable schedule:
  • How to Use This for Your Decision. Launching a new store? Start with Digital Commerce.
  • What the Reports Don't Tell You. The reports are valuable. They give you a head start on where platforms sit relative to each other.
  • When to Ignore the MQ. I don't think you should ever ignore it. The report offers value and will inform your thinking.
  • Let's Talk. The Magic Quadrant won't make your decision for you.
